Scale Finder

Type in notes and instantly find every matching scale — all major modes, pentatonics, blues, harmonic minor and more.

Use # and b for sharps/flats: F#, Bb, Eb…

216 scales checked (18 types × 12 roots). Enharmonic equivalents (F# = Gb) are treated as the same pitch.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your notes separated by spaces (e.g. C D E F# G A B).
  2. Click "Find scales".
  3. Exact matches appear first with a badge; partial matches follow with coverage %.
  4. Click any result to see the full scale notes.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the matching work?

Notes you type are matched as subsets of each scale across all 12 roots. Exact matches (same notes) rank first, then partial matches by coverage.

How do I enter notes?

Write note names separated by spaces, e.g. "C E G" or "A C D E G". Use # and b for sharps and flats.

How many scales does it check?

18 scale types × 12 roots = 216 scales are checked against your notes.
